title: 3dMatch
description: Find similar subbricks and rearrange order to ease comparison. Part of FATCAT in AFNI.

inset.description: File with M subbricks of data to match against another file.
inset.title: Input file to match

refset.description: File with N subbricks, serving as a reference for INPUT_FILE.
refset.title: Reference file

mask.description: A mask of regions to include in the correlation of datasets.
mask.title: Mask file

in_min.description: Threshold below which values in INPUT_FILE will be zeroed during analysis.
in_min.title: Input minimum threshold

in_max.description: Threshold above which values in INPUT_FILE will be zeroed during analysis.
in_max.title: Input maximum threshold

ref_min.description: Threshold below which values in REF_FILE will be zeroed during analysis.
ref_min.title: Reference minimum threshold

ref_max.description: Threshold above which values in REF_FILE will be zeroed during analysis.
ref_max.title: Reference maximum threshold

prefix.description: Prefix for output name for BRIK/HEAD files and *_coeff.vals text files.
prefix.title: Output prefix

only_dice_thr.description: Apply thresholding only during Dice evaluation, not during spatial correlation.
only_dice_thr.title: Only Dice threshold flag
